dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Need a pillow? I can make one for you — I brought some cloth with me.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I also have a nice soft blanket here if you need a comforter.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Not interested? Well, I'm gonna take a nap anyway. Let me know when it's time to go.
